subject.title: fix(diagnostics): reclaim zombie embedded-run counters left idle by handle-mismatch clears

question: Should OpenClaw recover idle sessions with queueDepth 0 and stale active embedded-run diagnostics by force-clearing the active run after stuckSessionAbortMs?
rationale: This is a session-state and availability policy choice because it can unblock silent stalls but also expands active-abort recovery beyond queued or processing sessions, and the branch now conflicts with adjacent recovery changes.

options.title: Refresh And Land Bounded Recovery
options.body: Resolve the conflict, preserve current progress-age recovery, rerun focused diagnostics validation, and accept the idle active-abort policy for this stale-bookkeeping case.

options.title: Require Root-Cause Prevention First
options.body: Pause this mitigation until the handle-mismatch or dispatch path that creates the zombie counter is fixed and live-proven.

options.title: Fold Into Adjacent Recovery Work
options.body: Close or defer this branch only if a maintainer chooses an adjacent PR as the canonical fix and it demonstrably covers the idle/no-queue zombie state.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Land Bounded Recovery
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict, preserve current progress-age recovery, rerun focused diagnostics validation, and accept the idle active-abort policy for this stale-bookkeeping case.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored this recovery path and have recent merged work in the same diagnostic stuck-session recovery area.
